findings: learner.overview.text: “sound-bearing” alone does not explain why 叚 could serve as a sound cue, and the Qin-period proposal is presented without its essential uncertainty. Say the traditional analysis links 叚 and one reading of 假 through their similar reconstructed sounds, while noting that a separate proposal treats 人 as a spelling distinction and the analyses remain unresolved. Cite the matching Old Chinese evidence and the proposal.
